about: Ready posts to swap into calendar.json (same format). Swap: copy a post over an existing one and keep that one's n, day, date and weekday. Then run check-calendar.mjs.

posts.trend: "Is it worth the hype" review culture (§2, §3)
posts.caption:
The sight test. Food vloggers do taste tests after they order. We do the sight test before.

Read the menu line. Guess the size. Swipe to see the real plate.

Pehle andaza lagao, phir dekho.

How close was your guess? Comment "close" or "way off".
posts.alt: The sight test: read a menu line, guess the size, then see the real plate.

slides.h: Taste tests happen after you order. *Sight tests happen before.*

posts.trend: Worth-the-hype reviews + launch queues (§1 points 2 and 7)
posts.caption:
"Is it worth the hype?" is Lahore's favourite question. Usually you only find out after a two-hour queue and a full bill.

We would rather you found out before. See the dish at true size first, then decide if it is worth it.

Hype pe nahi, plate pe faisla karo.
posts.alt: Text post: is it worth the hype? Decide before you order.

slides.h:
"Is it worth the hype?"
*Decide before you order.*
slides.ru: Hype pe nahi, plate pe faisla karo.

posts.when: evergreen · good after any big Lahore opening
posts.caption:
New place opens. The queue goes round the block. Everyone posts the queue, nobody posts the menu.

Imagine standing in that line already knowing what you will order, because you have seen it on your table.

Line mein khade ho? Kam az kam order toh pakka ho.
posts.alt: Text post about restaurant opening queues in Lahore.

slides.h:
Two-hour queue.
*Zero idea what to order.*
slides.ru: Line mein khade ho? Kam az kam order toh pakka ho.

posts.trend: The "is this even real?" doubt, AI imagery everywhere (§1 summary)
posts.caption:
"Is this even real?" is a fair question in 2026. Half the food on your feed was never cooked.

Everything on MENVA is a scan of a real plate from a real kitchen. If it was not on the pass, it is not on the menu.

Asli plate. Asli size. Koi AI nahi.
posts.alt: A real steak sandwich with the words: is this even real? Yes.

slides.b: A scan of a real plate. No AI, ever.

posts.trend: "Expectation vs reality" meme format, done honestly (§2)
posts.caption:
Expectation vs reality, the MENVA version. Spoiler: they are the same picture.

That is the whole point of seeing a real scan before you order.

Umeed aur haqeeqat, aik hi plate.
posts.alt: Expectation vs reality: the same real dish twice.

slides.b: Umeed aur haqeeqat, aik hi plate.

posts.caption:
Every dessert place in Lahore has a Dubai chocolate bar now. Some are thick, some are thin, and you only find out which after you pay.

Dessert menus deserve a sight test too. Restaurants: imagine your version on the guest's table, at true size, before they order. DM "PILOT".

Pehle dekho, phir cut karo.
posts.alt: Text post about the Dubai chocolate trend.

slides.h: Every café has a Dubai chocolate bar. *Which one is actually thick?*

posts.caption:
Every bakery in Lahore says theirs is the real three milk cake. Soaked, glossy, perfect slice. On the menu they all sound the same.

Next time, see the slice on your table before you order it.

Teen doodh, aik sawal: kitna bara slice?
posts.alt: Text post about three milk cake.

slides.h: Everyone has the *real* three milk cake.
slides.ru: Teen doodh, aik sawal: kitna bara slice?

posts.caption:
Single, double, triple smash. The menu gives you three words and a price. The size difference is the one thing you actually want to know.

This is what a 3D menu is for.

Double lein ya triple? Dekh ke batao.
posts.alt: Text post about smash burger sizes.

posts.when: Pakistan match nights (post manually on the day)
posts.caption:
Match night at a restaurant: the whole table watches the screen and nobody reads the menu.

Order the platter before the toss. See it on the table first so there are no surprises at the drinks break.

Toss se pehle order. Baqi sab match ke baad.
posts.alt: Text post for Pakistan cricket match nights.

slides.h: Order before the toss. *Watch in peace.*
slides.ru: Toss se pehle order. Baqi sab match ke baad.

posts.caption:
Ammi at home: "Ghar pe khana hai."
Ammi at the restaurant: "Yeh 'aioli' kya hota hai?"

Don't explain it. Show her. Tap the dish, put it on the table, done.

Tag the friend who has to translate the menu for their parents.
posts.alt: Text post: desi parents reading an English menu.

posts.caption:
Family dinner out: twelve people, three generations, one person ordering for everyone.

Show Nani the plate before it arrives, and there will be no "yeh kya mangwa liya" at the table.

Nani ko pehle dikha do. Phir koi shikayat nahi.
posts.alt: Text post about ordering for a big family dinner.

slides.ru: Nani ko pehle dikha do. Phir koi shikayat nahi.

If you are spending the week's budget on one dinner, see exactly what you are getting before you order it.

posts.caption:
Lahore has rooftops, neon signs and flower walls for photos. We think the best photo spot is your own table, with the dish on it before it even arrives.

Place it, screenshot it, post it. Camera khata pehle.

slides.h: The best photo spot is *your own table.*
slides.b: Place it. Screenshot it. Post it.

posts.trend: Launch queues fade; proof lasts (§1, §5 risks)
posts.caption:
Restaurant owners: opening-week hype fades. The queue goes, the reels stop, and the menu is left doing the selling on a quiet Tuesday.

Give it the plate to sell with: your real dishes, in 3D, at true size, on every table.

DM "PILOT". Lahore pilot: PKR 25,000.
posts.alt: Text post for restaurants: hype fades, the menu stays.

posts.trend: Food vloggers as the trust layer (§1 point 7)
posts.caption:
In Lahore, a food vlogger's verdict travels further than your own posts. But a vlogger visits once. Your guests visit every night.

MENVA lets every guest do their own review before they order: the real dish, on their table, true size.

DM "PILOT" for the Lahore pilot.
posts.alt: Text post for restaurants about food vloggers and guests.

slides.h: A vlogger visits once. *Your guests visit every night.*
slides.b: Let every guest see the plate before they order.
